Fish smarter and catch more with the help of Fishing Points – the ultimate tool providing the information you need for a seamless trip. Prepare for your fishing trip and find the best fishing times using fish activity forecast, tide prediction, weather forecast, wave and solunar data.

Save and find your favorite fishing locations, trotlines and trolling paths. Enjoy reliable GPS mapping and satellite view from Google Maps or use offline mode with accurate nautical charts (US - NOAA) for boating. Fishing Points was made for everyone, regardless of fishing preference – from saltwater anglers (inshore or offshore fishing at open seas and oceans) to freshwater fishermen (lakes, rivers, ponds) applying various fishing techniques. Fly fishing, bass fishing, boat fishing, kayak fishing, or ice fishing – Fishing Points covers it all.

Save the details of every catch (photos, weight, length) with Fishing Points. Take notes on bait, fishing spots, and get ideal times when to go fishing thanks to automatic up-to-date information. Check weather, sun, moon, and marine conditions conveniently to set course towards your next spot. Make the most of your next trip with Fishing Points today.

FIND LOCATIONS
• Save fishing hotspots to conveniently find them next time using GPS
• Enjoy waypoints with 40+ new markers and 10 colors to choose from
• Get information and quickly locate more than 50.000 boat ramps worldwide
• Record & draw trolling paths or trotlines while fishing
• Know your depths and find the best spots anywhere with worldwide nautical charts
• Boat ramps locations with details on the map
• Fish and set anchor location, measure distances, monitor movements and get alerted if you exceed allowed distance

FISHING FORECAST
• Daily fish activity forecast
• Prepare for your trip with hourly updates
• Find the best fishing times with our in-app calendar
• Fish during feeding times to secure a catch (major and minor times)

MARINE FORECAST
• Tide prediction charts
• Information on daily low & high tides
• Marine forecast with hourly wave reports (waves, swell, wind)
• Check sea temperature (SST) and currents

WEATHER FORECAST
• Current weather conditions and hourly forecast
• Wind forecast
• Barometer and air pressure data
• Get severe weather alerts

SOLUNAR DATA
• Sunrise & sunset times
• Moonrise & moonset times
• Sun & moon positions
• Moon phases
• Almanac

SYNC DATA
• Access your saved data across all your computer and mobile devices.
• Use Webapp to plan and analyze fishing trips on your computer. Try Webapp on https://web.fishingpoints.app

FISHING LOG
• Save fishing locations in your log to return later
• Record catches in a personal fishing log you can share with others
• Take notes about your catch and jot down important information after each trip
• Anglers from Florida, Texas & many other US states can check fish info, recent fishing regulations & bag limits for popular species.

SHARE
• Import kmz or gpx files from gps devices or other apps
• Share your locations and catch photos with friends
